Package com.example.thevms.ui.Event

Class AttendeeAdapter

java.lang.Object
androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.Adapter<com.example.thevms.ui.Event.AttendeeAdapter.ViewHolder>
com.example.thevms.ui.Event.AttendeeAdapter
public class AttendeeAdapter extends androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.Adapter<com.example.thevms.ui.Event.AttendeeAdapter.ViewHolder>
Adapter for displaying a list of attendees (entrants) in a RecyclerView. Provides filtering by status and CSV export functionality.

    • filterByStatus

      public void filterByStatus(String status)
      Called when the organizer picks a status from the dropdown. Filters the displayed list instantly.
      Parameters:
      status - The status to filter by (e.g., "waiting", "selected", "accepted", "rejected", "cancelled").

    • exportFilteredListAsCsv

      public void exportFilteredListAsCsv(Context context, String eventName)
      Exports the currently filtered list as a CSV and opens the Android share sheet. CSV columns: First Name, Last Name, Email, Status Called from OrganizerEventAdapter when tv_export_csv is tapped.
      Parameters:
      context - Used for file creation and launching the share intent.
      eventName - Used to name the file e.g. "SummerFest_waiting.csv"
